subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this PR merge only after a current-main refresh plus completed live Gemini thinking proof, or may maintainers accept source-level proof and the longer-silence default tradeoff?
rationale: The patch changes default cloud timeout semantics for existing thinking-model users and the available proof does not yet show the real reported provider path completing after the fix.

options.title: Require Refresh And Live Proof
options.body: Ask for a rebase/conflict resolution plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs or terminal output showing a non-off thinking turn no longer fails around 125s.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof

options.title: Replace The PR
options.body: If the default-timeout tradeoff is not acceptable, close this PR and request a narrower replacement that keeps a watchdog or adds an explicitly approved timeout mode.
